FN-BGGC4J4-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 294
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 294 as introduced could increase the obligations of the several counties, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2024, by an undetermined amount dependent upon any increase in compensation of
certain county positions equal to the compensation of the prior officeholder of that position,
including any uniform increases received by the prior officeholder.
Page 1
